blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong has reminded Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla that the role of the police is to ensure public safety and not cause panic, after the latter claimed that police officers are preparing for the worst possible scenario after the impeachment trial. Alonto Adiong in a press briefing on Monday said that the Philippine National Police (PNP) should be prepared whatever the scenario is — whether or not there is any politically-motivated movement due to Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. “Well whether or not there’s an ongoing […]...
